pending_interview.category: System design (general) — scalability patterns; designing common systems like a URL shortener, rate limiter, chat system, notification system
pending_interview.question: You are designing a rate limiter — a system that controls how many requests a user or service can make to an API within a given time window (for example, no more than 1,000 requests per minute per user). Walk through how you would design this at scale. What algorithm would you use to enforce the limits, where would you store the state, and how would you handle the case where your service runs on hundreds of servers simultaneously? What tradeoffs does your design involve?
